tldr_zh: Sam Altman呼籲放緩AI發展、微軟Xbox漲價、加州數據刪除法生效、AI藝術作品贏州博覽會
tldr_en: Sam Altman calls for AI deceleration; Microsoft raises Xbox prices; California data deletion law takes effect; AI art wins state fair.

items.title_zh: Sam Altman呼籲產業放緩AI發展步伐
items.title_en: Sam Altman Calls for Pacing AI Development
items.summary_zh: OpenAI創始人Sam Altman近日表示，應該放緩AI發展速度。此舉引發業界對AI發展節奏的廣泛討論，在AI加速與安全平衡之間尋求共識。
items.summary_en: OpenAI co-founder Sam Altman has called for the industry to pace AI development. This sparked broader industry debate on balancing rapid advancement with safety concerns.

items.title_zh: 前OpenAI董事籲AI企業提高透明度應對安全隱患
items.title_en: Former OpenAI Director Urges AI Firms to Increase Transparency
items.summary_zh: 前OpenAI董事唐納表示，許多AI安全工作者擔心若不採取行動，可能招致嚴重災難。她強調主要AI企業必須增加透明度，加強行業監管。
items.summary_en: A former OpenAI board member warned that without action, AI incidents could escalate to catastrophic levels. She emphasized major AI companies must boost transparency and strengthen oversight.

items.title_zh: AI海報作品意外贏得俄亥俄州博覽會大賽
items.title_en: AI-Generated Poster Wins Ohio State Fair Contest
items.summary_zh: 一件由AI創作的海報作品在俄亥俄州博覽會比賽中贏得獎項，引發對AI創意競爭與藝術認可的思考。
items.summary_en: An AI-generated poster won a contest at the Ohio State Fair, sparking discussions about AI's role in creative competitions and artistic recognition.

items.title_zh: AI藝術家在付費協議下創作作品爭議
items.title_en: Paid Artist Agreements Not Stopping AI Controversy
items.summary_zh: 雖然部分AI公司開始向藝術家支付費用以使用其作品訓練模型，但這仍難以解決插畫家們對版權侵害的長期擔憂。業界仍存在根本性的信任與公平問題。
items.summary_en: While some AI companies have begun paying artists for training data, paid agreements haven't resolved illustrators' core concerns about copyright infringement and fair compensation practices.

items.title_zh: 微軟Xbox價格暴漲　歐洲上調最高200歐元
items.title_en: Microsoft Raises Xbox Prices Up to €200 in Europe
items.summary_zh: 繼美國漲價後，微軟現公布歐元區與英國的Xbox價格上調方案，最高漲幅達200歐元或170英鎊，引發玩家不滿。
items.summary_en: Following US price increases, Microsoft announced Xbox price hikes in the EU and UK, with increases up to €200 or £170, sparking player backlash.

items.title_zh: Google Pixel 11規格與價格曝光　起價上漲百元
items.title_en: Google Pixel 11 Specs and Pricing Leaked
items.summary_zh: Android Headlines披露Pixel 11系列規格與價格，起價從799美元升至899美元，漲幅100美元，但將配置256GB儲存。
items.summary_en: Pixel 11 lineup pricing revealed with $100 price increase starting at $899, offering 256GB storage across the range.

items.title_zh: 全球記憶體短缺影響MacBook Air供應
items.title_en: Global Memory Chip Shortage Hits MacBook Air Availability
items.summary_zh: 全球記憶體晶片短缺問題延燒至Apple最暢銷的Mac產品MacBook Air，導致供應受限。
items.summary_en: Global memory chip shortages are affecting the availability of Apple's most popular Mac model, the MacBook Air.

items.title_zh: 馬來西亞關閉Balaji Srinivasan Network School科技學校
items.title_en: Malaysia Shuts Down Balaji Srinivasan's Network School
items.summary_zh: 馬來西亞當局據報關閉知名科技創業家Balaji Srinivasan在當地創辦的Network School，該校自稱為「科技樂觀主義者的前沿社區」。
items.summary_en: Malaysia has reportedly shut down Network School founded by prominent tech entrepreneur Balaji Srinivasan, which positioned itself as a hub for techno-optimists.

items.title_zh: 法官否決xAI禁令　明尼蘇達州涉淫穢AI應用禁令可生效
items.title_en: Judge Blocks xAI Challenge to Minnesota Nudify App Ban
items.summary_zh: 儘管xAI提起訴訟反對，明尼蘇達州禁止「脫衣應用」的法令仍可正式生效，顯示州政府在AI濫用監管上的決心。
items.summary_en: Despite xAI's legal challenge, Minnesota's ban on apps that generate nude images can proceed, demonstrating state-level AI misuse regulation.

items.title_zh: 加州數據刪除請求法案DROP正式生效
items.title_en: California Data Deletion Law (DROP) Becomes Enforceable
items.summary_zh: 加州消費者數據刪除法案DROP自8月1日起正式生效，民眾可強制要求企業刪除個人數據，標誌隱私保護監管新里程。
items.summary_en: California's data deletion law (DROP) becomes enforceable on August 1st, allowing consumers to require companies to delete personal data.

items.title_zh: 川普宣布暫停對伊朗新軍事行動　油價應聲下跌
items.title_en: Trump Halts New Iran Strikes; Oil Prices Drop
items.summary_zh: 美國總統川普宣佈暫停對伊朗的軍事行動，聲稱伊朗與中東國家要求保持克制以便進行談判。此舉導致油價立即下滑。
items.summary_en: President Trump announced a hold on new military strikes against Iran, claiming Iran and Middle Eastern nations requested restraint for negotiations, causing oil prices to fall.

items.title_zh: 加拿大西捷航空4400空服員罷工　影響逾25萬旅客
items.title_en: WestJet Flight Attendants Strike; Over 250,000 Passengers Affected
items.summary_zh: 加拿大第二大航空公司西捷航空4400名空服員因勞資談判破裂罷工，每日600多班次取消，暑期旅遊旺季逾25萬旅客行程受阻。
items.summary_en: WestJet flight attendants strike after failed negotiations, canceling over 600 daily flights and affecting more than 250,000 passengers during peak summer travel season.

items.title_zh: 希臘滅火直升機空中相撞　2人喪命
items.title_en: Two Killed in Firefighting Helicopter Collision in Greece
items.summary_zh: 希臘兩架滅火直升機在撲滅野火任務中發生空中相撞，一名丹麥籍與一名希臘籍組員罹難，一名英國籍飛行員倖存。
items.summary_en: Two firefighting helicopters collided over Greece during wildfire operations, killing a Danish and Greek crew member while a British pilot survived.

items.title_zh: 中國監控平台意外曝光　追蹤外籍人士動態
items.title_en: China's Overseas Surveillance Platform Accidentally Exposed
items.summary_zh: 紐約時報調查發現，中國張家口公安局曾使用未加密的「海外人士動態控制平台」，監控記者、留學生等外籍人士，並利用臉孔辨識系統追蹤其活動。
items.summary_en: New York Times investigation reveals China's unencrypted overseas surveillance platform tracked foreign journalists and students, using facial recognition to monitor their movements.
